title: 第1章 武脉重开第2章 想死我成全你
slug: 九阳武神第4746章是时候清场了
content_zh:
大秦帝国。
圆月城。
圆月学宫。
这一天。
天气晴朗。
圆月学宫的一间学堂之中，几十个少年，正在专心听讲。
这是一节武道理论课。
此时。
讲堂之上，一个武师，正在给这些初级班的学员，讲解着一些武道的基础理论知识。
一双双充满求知欲的眼睛，盯着武师，专心听讲。
不过，有一个叫叶云飞的少年却是例外，正趴在桌子上呼呼大睡。
讲台上，那个武师也是注意到了正在睡觉的叶云飞，先是一怒，然后叹气，摇了摇头。
“这家伙又在学堂上公然睡觉了。”
“他这一辈子，已经没希望，是在破罐子破摔。”
学堂中的其他学员，注意到了武师叹气的表情，不由得悄声议论。
叶云飞，圆月城叶家家主的儿子。
当年，进入圆月学宫，才一天，就开脉成功。
仅仅半年，就一口气突破到炼体三重。
被称为圆月学宫史上最惊艳的天才！
也为叶家带来巨大的声誉和希望。

可惜，后来，叶云飞体内的八条武脉，一夜之间全部消失，成为没法修武的废人。
从此，天才变废物！
“听说，他的未婚妻施小蝶，已经和秦家的大少爷秦安公然勾搭上了。
这废物的头顶，可是绿油油一片了。”
“据说，在叶家，也是人人嫌弃他，嘲讽他，视他为灾星。
甚至，他父亲也受到连累，家主的地位，岌岌可危。”
“我收到消息，叶家的长老会已经决定，三天后的叶家族会，将会宣布，把叶云飞派往一个偏僻的小镇，管理那个小镇上叶家的产业。”
“说得好听点，是去管理叶家在那个小镇上的产业。
实际上，是被流放，这一辈子，只能老死在那个偏僻荒凉的小镇上了。”
……
一道道充满不屑的议论声，悄声响起。
“叶云飞，你醒醒吧，曹武师这一节课所讲解的内容，很重要。”
此时，和叶云飞坐在同一桌，一个明眸皓齿，宛若出水芙蓉般的女孩，轻轻用手碰了碰叶云飞，小声提醒，声音清脆而又悦耳。
这个女孩，叫苏青洛，是圆月学宫的四大美女之一，宫花级的人物。
是整个圆月学宫，所有男学员心目中的女神！
“我好像重生了！”
叫叶云飞的少年，猛地抬头，睁开双眼，打量着周围的环境，那清秀的脸容之上，目光中是浓浓的震惊之色。
叶云飞，鸿蒙界有史以来，最年轻的天帝！
修武仅仅一千年，就登临世界最高峰，世人敬称叶天帝。
也是鸿蒙界之中，唯一一个，能迎来成神劫的天帝。

不过，叶云飞在渡劫的时候，突然遭到了鸿蒙位面其他三个天帝的偷袭，不但渡劫失败，还差点形神俱灭。
在最危急的生死关头，叶云飞施展混沌轮回诀，逆转时间，颠倒空间，让一缕残魂，成功穿越时空，侥幸逃过一死。
叶云飞想不到的是，自己竟然重生回到了少年时代。
content_en:
The Qin Empire.
Full Moon City.
Full Moon Academy.
This day.
it's clear.
In a school room of Yuanyue Academy, dozens of teenagers were listening attentively.
This is a martial arts theory class.
at this time.
Above the lecture hall, a martial arts master was explaining some basic theoretical knowledge of martial arts to these junior class students.
A pair of eyes full of curiosity stared at the martial artist, listening intently.
However, there was an exception for a young man named Ye Yunfei, who was lying on the table and sleeping soundly.
On the podium, the martial artist also noticed Ye Yunfei who was sleeping. He was angry at first, then sighed and shook his head.
"This guy openly slept in class again."
"He has no hope in this life. He is just trying to break the pot."
Other students in the school noticed the martial arts master's sighing expression and couldn't help but whisper.
Ye Yunfei, the son of the head of the Ye family in Yuanyue City.
Back then, he successfully opened his pulse just one day after entering Yuanyue Academy.
In just half a year, he broke through to the third level of body refining in one go.
Known as the most amazing genius in the history of Yuanyue Academy!
It also brought great reputation and hope to the Ye family.
Unfortunately, later, all eight martial arts veins in Ye Yunfei's body disappeared overnight, and he became a useless person unable to practice martial arts.
From then on, genius turned into waste!
"I heard that his fiancée Shi Xiaodie has openly hooked up with Qin An, the eldest young master of the Qin family.
The top of this waste's head is completely green. "
"It is said that in the Ye family, everyone despised him, ridiculed him, and regarded him as a disaster star.
Even his father was implicated, and the status of the family head was in jeopardy. "
"I received news that the Ye family's elders' council has decided that the Ye family meeting in three days will announce that Ye Yunfei will be sent to a remote town to manage the Ye family's property in that town."
“To put it nicely, it’s to manage the Ye family’s property in that small town.
In fact, he was exiled and had no choice but to die of old age in that remote and desolate town for the rest of his life. "
…
A series of disdainful comments sounded quietly.
"Ye Yunfei, wake up. What Martial Master Cao explains in this class is very important."
At this time, sitting at the same table as Ye Yunfei, a girl with bright eyes and white teeth, who looked like a hibiscus in water, gently touched Ye Yunfei with her hand and whispered a reminder in a clear and pleasant voice.
This girl, named Su Qingluo, is one of the four beauties of Yuanyue Academy and a palace-level figure.
She is the goddess in the eyes of all the male students in the entire Yuanyue Academy!
"I seem to be reborn!"
The young man named Ye Yunfei suddenly raised his head, opened his eyes, and looked at the surrounding environment. There was a look of shock in his eyes on his delicate face.
Ye Yunfei, the youngest Emperor of Heaven in the history of Hongmeng Realm!
After practicing martial arts for only a thousand years, he reached the highest peak in the world, and the world respected him as Emperor Ye Tian.
He is also the only Heavenly Emperor in the Hongmeng Realm who can usher in the calamity of becoming a god.
However, when Ye Yunfei was overcoming the tribulation, he was suddenly attacked by the other three Heavenly Emperors in the Hongmeng plane. Not only did he fail to overcome the tribulation, he was almost completely destroyed physically and mentally.
At the most critical moment of life and death, Ye Yunfei used the Chaos Reincarnation Technique to reverse time and space, allowing a ray of remnant soul to successfully travel through time and space, and narrowly escaped death.
What Ye Yunfei didn't expect was that he would be reborn and return to his boyhood.
